post.summary: Get rooms for the authenticated hotel
post.description: Retrieves a paginated list of room numbers for the authenticated hotel along with permission flags. Supports optional search by room number, room type, or filtering by specific room ID.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term to filter rooms by room number or room type

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Filter by specific room ID

200.description: Successful response with paginated rooms and permissions

post.summary: Add a new room for the authenticated hotel
post.description: Creates a new room for the authenticated hotel's account. If the room number was previously soft-deleted, it will be restored.

422.description: Validation error or room number already exists

message.example: Room Number already exists for this hotel.

post.description: Deletes a room record from the authenticated hotel by the provided room ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the room to be deleted

post.description: Updates a room's number and type for the authenticated hotel. Room numbers must be unique within the hotel.

id.description: ID of the room to update

post.description: Toggles the status of a room between active (1) and inactive (0).

id.description: ID of the room to change status

post.summary: Get employees for the authenticated hotel
post.description: Retrieves a paginated list of employees associated with the hotel of the authenticated user. Supports search by employee name, contact number, and filter by employee ID.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term to filter employees by name or contact number

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Filter employees by specific employee ID

200.description: Successful response with paginated employee data

post.description: Creates a new hotel employee and associates them with a user account.

items.example: This email has already been taken.

post.description: Updates hotel employee details and optionally document IDs (documents should be uploaded separately).

documents.description: Optional: Document IDs mapped to file names or paths (if already uploaded).

post.description: Deletes a hotel employee, their associated user account, and their documents.

id.description: ID of the hotel employee to delete

post.description: Toggles the status of a hotel employee between active and inactive. Also updates the associated user's status.

id.description: ID of the hotel employee whose status will be toggled

post.description: Retrieves hotel bookings for the authenticated hotel owner or employee. Hotel owners see all their hotel bookings; employees see only their own. Supports search, date range filtering, and specific booking or transfer date lookups.

search.description: Search guest name, contact number, or room number

hotel_id.description: Hotel ID used with transfer date filter

post.summary: Create a hotel booking with guest and member information

idProof.description: ID proof file (base64 or file URL)
Member ID proof (base64 or file reference)

post.description: Deletes a hotel booking by ID. If the booking has associated members, they will also be deleted.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the hotel booking to delete

post.description: Fetches the details of a specific hotel booking by its ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the booking to view

post.summary: Get booking members by parent booking ID
post.description: Retrieves a paginated list of hotel booking members (child bookings) associated with the provided parent booking ID. Supports search by guest name, contact number, and room number.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: The parent booking ID to retrieve members for

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking ID to retrieve details for

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term to filter members by guest name, contact number, or room number

post.summary: Add a new member to a booking
post.description: Creates a new hotel booking member under an existing booking. Requires authentication.
Deletes a member from a hotel booking by their booking ID. Requires authentication.

id.description: The ID of the member booking record to delete

post.summary: Get visitors for a hotel booking
post.description: Retrieves a paginated list of visitors associated with a specific hotel booking. Supports optional search by visitor name or contact number.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The booking ID to retrieve visitors for

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The booking ID to retrieve visitors for

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term to filter visitors by name or contact number

200.description: Successful response with paginated visitors and permissions

post.description: Adds a new visitor associated with a booking. Supports providing visitor details and an optional ID proof path as a string (e.g., file path).

booking_id.description: Booking ID to associate the visitor with

id_proof_path.description: Optional path of the ID proof document

post.description: Deletes a visitor by its ID. Logs the action performed by the authenticated user.

id.description: ID of the visitor to be deleted

post.summary: Get paginated transfer entries with filtering
post.description: Retrieve transfer entries for the authenticated user, with optional filters for date range and hotel. Groups results by hotel and transfer date.

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.description: Start date for filtering transfer entries (format: Y-m-d)

parameters.name: to_date
parameters.description: End date for filtering transfer entries (format: Y-m-d)

post.description: Retrieves all hotel bookings for the authenticated hotel that have a status of 0 and a check-in date up to and including the day after tomorrow.

200.description: Successful response with a list of pending transfer bookings

post.description: Marks the selected hotel bookings as transferred and creates a transfer entry for the authenticated hotel or employee.

booking_ids.description: Array of booking IDs to transfer

post.description: Saves the file paths of uploaded register entries and marks them as transferred. This expects file paths (strings), not binary uploads.

file_path.description: Array of file paths (as strings) for the uploaded files

200.description: File paths saved and marked as transferred successfully

message.example: File uploaded and marked as transferred successfully.
Please provide at least one file path.

post.description: Fetches uploaded register entries for the authenticated hotel or hotel employee. If 'hotel_id' and 'date' are provided, it filters based on a matching uploaded transfer entry.

hotel_id.description: ID of the hotel (required with date to filter specific entry)

date.description: Date of the transfer to filter uploaded register

post.description: Retrieves a list of available room numbers for the authenticated hotel or hotel employee based on the given check-in date. Excludes rooms already booked for the given date.

check_in.description: Check-in date and time in Y-m-d\\TH:i:s format

200.description: Successful response with a list of available rooms

422.description: Validation error when check-in date is missing or invalid

403.description: Unauthorized access if user is not a hotel or hotel employee

get.description: Retrieve all documents with their ID, name, and status.
Retrieve all states with their ID, name, and status.
Retrieve all cities with their ID, name, state details, and status.

parameters.name: state_id
parameters.description: Filter cities by state ID

get.description: Retrieve all menus with their ID, name, and status.

get.summary: Get notifications for the authenticated user
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notifications. For hotels and hotel employees, notifications from their associated Police Station or SP Office are fetched. Super Admin gets all notifications.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination

post.description: Fetches a list of notifications based on user type. Hotel owners and employees only receive notifications relevant to their associated police station or SP office. Super Admin and other roles get all notifications.

message.example: All hotels must submit their records by tomorrow.

user.description: Details of the user who created the notification

get.summary: Get police stations by city ID
get.description: Returns a list of police stations filtered by the given city ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: City ID to filter police stations

post.description: Allows authenticated users to create a new notification. The image should be sent as a URL or base64 string.

message.description: The message content of the notification
message.example: All hotels must submit their records by tomorrow.

image.description: Optional image in base64 format or a valid image URL

post.description: Deletes a notification belonging to the authenticated user.

id.description: ID of the notification to delete

post.description: Marks a specific notification as read by the authenticated user.

post.summary: Get all notifications sent by the authenticated user

200.description: List of notifications sent by the user

id.description: ID of the notification to delete

get.summary: Get Hotel or HotelEmployee details based on user type
get.description: Returns hotel details if the user is of type 4, or hotel employee details if the user is of type 5. Unauthorized otherwise.

post.summary: Update hotel owner or hotel employee profile
post.description: Updates the profile information of a hotel owner (user_type_id = 4) or a hotel employee (user_type_id = 5).

items.example: The email has already been taken.

post.description: Logs in a user (only for user types 4 and 5).

403.description: Forbidden - Unauthorized user type or deactivated account

message.example: You do not have permission to login via the app.

post.description: Send a password reset link to the provided email address.
Reset the user's password using the provided token.

get.description: Returns dashboard statistics based on the authenticated user's role (Hotel Owner or Hotel Employee).

post.description: Logs out the authenticated user by deleting the current access token.

error.example: An error occurred during logout: error details here.

post.summary: Get filtered graph data for bookings and transfers
post.description: Retrieves daily hotel bookings and transfer counts between a specified date range for the authenticated hotel owner or employee. Returns empty data for unauthorized users.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date for filtering data (Y-m-d format). Defaults to the start of the current month.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date for filtering data (Y-m-d format). Defaults to the end of the current month.

message.example: The device token field is required.

post.description: Handles hotel registration along with associated user and documents (in JSON).

documents.description: Array of uploaded documents in base64 or metadata
